scope: Open expert consensus on initial drug therapy and aerosol delivery for acute asthma and COPD exacerbations.

keyRecommendations.text: Salbutamol plus ipratropium remains the mainstay of initial therapy for both acute asthma and COPD exacerbations.
The panel prioritised early corticosteroid therapy and optimising bronchodilator dosing to limit toxicity.
The panel reached unanimous consensus that aerosol delivery device selection significantly influences treatment success.

clinicalBottomLine: Start acute asthma and COPD exacerbations with salbutamol plus ipratropium, give corticosteroids early, and choose the aerosol device deliberately because the panel judged device choice to affect success.
notableCaveats: This is a device-and-initial-therapy consensus, not a full ICU ventilation guideline.

source.title: Saudi expert consensus on the management of acute asthma and COPD exacerbations with algorithm of aerosol drug delivery device recommendations.
